subject: AWS marketplace consolidated usage bucket mismatch & tax holdback plan
messages:
From: AWS Marketplace Billing <marketplace-support@amazon.com>
To: jonas_weber; Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@prodtech.io>
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@prodtech.io>
Date: Fri, 4 Oct 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discrepancy: Consolidated usage buckets attributed across seller entities (Sep invoice)

Hi Jonas / Amanda —

We flagged an inconsistency on the Sep 2029 consolidated invoice for ProdTech Inc. Several usage rows (consolidated bucket IDs starting with cbkt-7a4) were credited to a different seller entity in our ledger than the one appearing on your consolidated report. This created a net mismatch of $37,842 on the marketplace invoice and triggered an automated tax/withholding holdback for EU VAT review.

What we need from you to accelerate resolution:
- CSV of your internal mapping between customer project IDs and AWS seller entity IDs (sample provided below).
- Any evidence showing the original purchaser/tenant for the listed usage IDs.
- PO or billing contact confirmation to release the holdback once mapping is confirmed.

We've attached the raw invoice extract (aws_invoice_sep2029.pdf) and a short sample of affected rows. If you can provide the evidence bundle and a reconciliation playbook, we can escalate removal of the automated holdback.

Regards,
Marketplace Support
AWS Marketplace

Attachments: aws_invoice_sep2029.pdf (invoice extract), affected_rows_sample.csv

From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: AWS Marketplace Billing <marketplace-support@amazon.com>; Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@prodtech.io>
Cc: marissa_cole; vanessa_ortiz
Date: Fri, 4 Oct 2029 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Consolidated usage buckets attributed across seller entities (Sep invoice)

Thanks — we see the same discrepancy on our side. Amanda, can you pull the customer-side project-to-tenant mapping for the cbkt-7a4* rows and attach it here?

Internal note to Marissa / Vanessa: this looks like the same pattern we saw in July where a consolidated ingestion job re-assigned usage IDs during a migration. Quick plan:
1) Amanda to provide ProdTech mapping + PO confirmation (today/T+1).
2) Marissa to assemble evidence bundle (usage CSV with timestamps, tenant IDs, invoices).
3) Vanessa to coordinate release request with AWS once evidence is uploaded to the Drive link below.

Jonas Weber
Head of Marketplace Finance Studies
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: evidence_bucket_mapping.xlsx (placeholder)

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber; vanessa_ortiz; Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@prodtech.io>
Cc: naomi_feldman
Date: Fri, 4 Oct 2029 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Consolidated usage buckets attributed across seller entities (Sep invoice)

Adding the evidence checklist and ETA. I'm compiling the reconciliation CSV now — will include:
- timestamped raw usage lines pulled from ingestion (UTC)
- internal project_id -> tenant_id mapping export
- billing_line_id -> cbkt id crosswalk
- sample signed PO from ProdTech for Q3 usage (if Finance provides)

ETA: I can have the full bundle uploaded to the Drive folder by Mon 10/7 EOD PST. Naomi, can you confirm whether we should request a provisional release of the holdback or wait for full mapping? My recommendation: request provisional release for the non-EU portion while we continue mapping EU-tagged rows. That will reduce customer impact.

Marissa Cole
Marketplace Reconciliation Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: prodtech_monthly_usage.csv (will be uploaded)

From: Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@prodtech.io>
To: jonas_weber; marissa_cole; vanessa_ortiz
Cc: Finance Ops <finance@prodtech.io>
Date: Mon, 7 Oct 2029 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Consolidated usage buckets attributed across seller entities (Sep invoice)

Thanks team — attached is the tenant mapping extract (see evidence_bucket_mapping.xlsx) and our internal reconciliation note. Finance confirms PO-4892 covers the majority of the disputed lines; I've copied Finance Ops. We can sign a statement certifying the buyer/tenant for the cbkt-7a4* rows if that helps.

Next steps from our side:
- Upload the signed PO and tenant mapping to your Drive link by EOD today.
- Approve provisional release for US and APAC usage only. EU rows remain under review (we will provide VAT evidence).

If AWS needs any additional attestations, we can have a director sign.

Best,
Amanda Lee
Head of Cloud Procurement
ProdTech Inc.

Attachments: evidence_bucket_mapping.xlsx, PO-4892_signed.pdf

From: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: jonas_weber; marissa_cole; Amanda Lee <amanda.lee@prodtech.io>
Cc: naomi_feldman; marketplace-support@amazon.com
Date: Mon, 7 Oct 2029 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discrepancy: Consolidated usage buckets attributed across seller entities (Sep invoice)

Quick status update and action items (finalizing playbook):
- Marissa: upload full evidence bundle (prodtech_monthly_usage.csv, ingestion logs, crosswalk) to Drive. (By EOD 10/07)
- Naomi: prepare a redlined release request to AWS that separates non-EU vs EU rows and cites PO-4892 for provisional release. (By Tue 10/08 noon PST)
- Jonas: once Naomi has the release request, please sign-off and I'll submit to Amazon's expedited disputes queue (JIRA: BILL-4821).

We will request AWS to release the $29,154 portion while EU VAT rows ($8,688) remain on hold pending VAT evidence. Amanda please confirm the Drive upload when complete. Once we have confirmation, I'll open the JIRA and attach the bundle.

Thanks — will track progress in the ticket.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head, Billing Operations
Redwood Inference
